SESSION	CREATE TEMPORARY VIEW t1 AS SELECT * FROM VALUES (1) AS GROUPING(a)
SESSION	CREATE TEMPORARY VIEW t2 AS SELECT * FROM VALUES (1) AS GROUPING(a)
SESSION	CREATE TEMPORARY VIEW empty_table as SELECT a FROM t2 WHERE false
READ	SELECT * FROM t1 INNER JOIN empty_table
READ	SELECT * FROM t1 CROSS JOIN empty_table
READ	SELECT * FROM t1 LEFT OUTER JOIN empty_table
READ	SELECT * FROM t1 RIGHT OUTER JOIN empty_table
READ	SELECT * FROM t1 FULL OUTER JOIN empty_table
READ	SELECT * FROM t1 LEFT SEMI JOIN empty_table
READ	SELECT * FROM t1 LEFT ANTI JOIN empty_table
READ	SELECT * FROM empty_table INNER JOIN t1
READ	SELECT * FROM empty_table CROSS JOIN t1
READ	SELECT * FROM empty_table LEFT OUTER JOIN t1
READ	SELECT * FROM empty_table RIGHT OUTER JOIN t1
READ	SELECT * FROM empty_table FULL OUTER JOIN t1
READ	SELECT * FROM empty_table LEFT SEMI JOIN t1
READ	SELECT * FROM empty_table LEFT ANTI JOIN t1
READ	SELECT * FROM empty_table INNER JOIN empty_table
READ	SELECT * FROM empty_table CROSS JOIN empty_table
READ	SELECT * FROM empty_table LEFT OUTER JOIN empty_table
READ	SELECT * FROM empty_table RIGHT OUTER JOIN empty_table
READ	SELECT * FROM empty_table FULL OUTER JOIN empty_table
READ	SELECT * FROM empty_table LEFT SEMI JOIN empty_table
READ	SELECT * FROM empty_table LEFT ANTI JOIN empty_table
